proof_spine: Name the two repeated outer objects: the countable union and its probability terms.
Apply countable additivity while keeping the one-use inner event sequence canonical.
Use uniqueness of the series sum and identify the named union with A union B.

blocks.intent: Replace repeated expanded probability constructions with two outer local mathematical objects.

thm probability_of_disjoint_union:
    ? forall [ProbabilitySpaceSetting(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, union_probability)], A, B union_probability_events:
        intersect(A, B) = {}
        =>:
            union(A, B) $in union_probability_events
            union_probability(union(A, B)) = union_probability(A) + union_probability(B)
    have event_sequence fn(n N+) union_probability_events = fn(n N+) union_probability_events {\two_event_sequence<union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events>(A, B, n)}
    let event_union = index_union(N+, union_probability_Omega, fn(n N+) power_set(union_probability_Omega) {event_sequence(n)})
    have probability_terms seq(R) = fn(n N+) R {union_probability(event_sequence(n))}
    by thm two_event_sequence_countable_union(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, A, B) => event_union = union(A, B)
    by thm event_countable_union_is_event(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, event_sequence) => event_union $in union_probability_events
    union(A, B) $in union_probability_events
    by thm two_event_sequence_pairwise_disjoint(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, A, B) => $pairwise_disjoint_event_sequence(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, event_sequence)
    by thm kolmogorov_countable_additivity(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, union_probability, event_sequence)
    by thm two_event_probability_series_has_sum(union_probability_Omega, union_probability_events, union_probability, A, B) => $has_series_sum(probability_terms, union_probability(A) + union_probability(B))
    by thm series_sum_unique(probability_terms, union_probability(event_union), union_probability(A) + union_probability(B)) => union_probability(event_union) = union_probability(A) + union_probability(B)
    union_probability(union(A, B)) = union_probability(event_union) = union_probability(A) + union_probability(B)

blocks.reusable_lesson: Name repeated outer mathematical objects; do not alias an inner function when doing so creates transport under a larger constructor. Exact outer aliases can often be consumed directly by later theorem premise checks without publishing equality-transport echoes.
